chart.what_the_drawing_says: A multi-year DOGE view: price has round-tripped from a ~0.47 spike back to 0.0738, sitting on a green support band at roughly 0.052-0.074 which he is treating as the buy zone, with 0.74260 marked as the far-overhead objective and the red moving average rolling over above price at 0.148.
chart.note_on_scale: The price axis extends into negative values (-0.05000 to -0.20000), which means a drawn object extends below zero; that object is not otherwise visible in the crop.

claims: Start putting and locking money in alt coins
notes: The chart's instrument title is truncated to '...' and is UNREADABLE, so symbol, timeframe and venue are null. The message 'Buying doge here' directly above it plus the price scale strongly imply DOGE, but that is inferred from text, not read from the chart header. The bar countdown reads '6d 5h', which implies a weekly (1W) candle - an inference, not a printed timeframe, so chart.timeframe is left null. The green tags 0.07001 and 0.05225 are stacked immediately under the live-price tag, so their tags are vertically displaced from the lines they belong to; the prices are read verbatim but the exact line each one belongs to is ambiguous (noted in drawn_objects). The price axis running to -0.20000 indicates an off-screen drawn object below zero. The 'Link, XRP' and 'I'm heavy on these' lines are grouped under the 02/07/2026 17:08 header with no individual timestamps. A further message begins at the very bottom of the screen but is obscured by the '#ticket-0514' banner and is unreadable.
